executiveSummary: The latest tech news highlights AI-driven memory shortages affecting Apple's MacBook Air supply, while Microsoft's Xbox prices are increasing, and Fender's CEO discusses the role of AI in music.

takeaways.title: MacBook Air supply shortages
takeaways.description: Due to AI datacenter buildout causing a global memory chip shortage, making it difficult to come across consumer-grade memory and storage for Apple's MacBook Air.

takeaways.title: Xbox pricing increase
takeaways.description: Microsoft's Xbox prices are increasing by up to €200 or £170 depending on the model, with some specific price hikes mentioned in the article.

takeaways.title: AI-driven music industry changes
takeaways.description: Fender's CEO discusses AI and music, while a musician mentions the role of AI in their work, highlighting changing trends in the music industry.

worthWatching: The potential impact of Apple's new Upgrade program on smartphone ownership and the shift towards leasing products.
How AI is changing the music industry, with some artists expressing concerns over generative AI and its use in their work.
engineeringPerspective: The technical challenge of managing global memory chip shortages and their impact on consumer electronics supply chains.
A potential opportunity for software engineers to explore new applications for Apple's Upgrade program, such as integrating it with existing workflows or developing custom leasing solutions.
